findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hardcoded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source code, or Lambda console/API.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables, leaving sensitive data (including the embedded credentials) protected only by the default AWS-managed key rather than a customer-controlled key, weakening encryption-at-rest guarantees.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life/deprecated runtime no longer receiving security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
